titles: Welcome to Villa Luxury Ulika - Istria
descriptions: Experience luxury in a perfect ambiance.
Gather, grill, and enjoy stylish moments together.

About.title: Overview
About.des: In the very heart of Istria, on the edge of peaceful Vodnjan, stands a villa that breathes harmony and elegance. Surrounded by olive trees and the scents of Mediterranean herbs, hidden from view and from the bustle of town, it has become a refuge for those who seek rest in its purest form.
About.des2:
In its stone and in the bold tones of its walls, you feel the balance between contemporary luxury and the Istrian spirit. Beyond the large glass walls lies a space where the day begins with the aroma of coffee and ends in a silence broken only by the sound of water from the pool. Four rooms, each with its own character, tell a story of comfort, while four bathrooms reflect the play of light and stone.

In the garden, under the shade of the pergola, the days pass slowly. On the table, fresh fruit, a glass of Istrian wine, and a view that disappears into the greenery. By the pool, sun-warmed stone and the sound of laughter carrying through the space. In the evening, when the sky washes over with the colours of sunset, the scent of the grill fills the air, and the lights from the terrace turn the courtyard into an intimate theatre under the stars.

This villa is not only a place to stay — it is an experience. A space in which time flows differently, where the spirit of Istria is felt in every detail, and where you find peace without looking for it.

the_space.title: The space
the_space.des:
Villa Luxury Ulika has been carefully arranged to offer guests comfort, privacy and a relaxing stay surrounded by nature. The spacious interior, a private wellness area and the landscaped outdoor space make it an ideal choice for families and friends who want to escape the rush of everyday life.

**Bedrooms and bathrooms**

The villa has four air-conditioned bedrooms, each with its own television. On the upper floor there are two bedrooms with double beds, and each has its own dressing room (walk-in wardrobe). On the same floor there is also a large shared bathroom.

On the ground floor there are two more bedrooms. One has a double bed, while the other has two separate beds. Both rooms have their own bathroom.

**Living room, kitchen and library**

The spacious living room is ideal for spending time together and relaxing. It is furnished with a comfortable three-seater sofa, a two-seater and an armchair, a large Smart TV and speakers.

The fully equipped kitchen contains a large double-door refrigerator with a freezer, a gas stove, an oven, a microwave, a dishwasher and a washing machine. Guests have filter-coffee and espresso machines, crockery, cooking and eating utensils, and wine and champagne glasses. Basic household supplies, equipment for drying laundry and a first-aid kit are also available. Next to the kitchen is a dining room with a table for ten, ideal for shared meals. In this part of the villa there is also an additional, smaller guest WC.

A special corner for relaxing is on the upper floor, where a library has been arranged with two comfortable armchairs surrounded by bookshelves. From this space there is a view of the living room and of the tall windows through which natural light enters.

**Private wellness area**

For moments of complete relaxation, guests have a private wellness area inside the villa. It is equipped with a Finnish sauna, a jacuzzi, two loungers and a shower cabin. Towels and essential oils for use in the sauna are provided, so that the wellness experience is even more pleasant. The wellness area is intended exclusively for the villa's guests and offers complete privacy during the stay.

**Heated pool and outdoor space**

In the fully fenced courtyard there is a private pool measuring 8 × 4 m, with a gradual transition from the shallower to the deeper part, to a maximum depth of approximately 1.5 m. The pool is heated from 1 May to 18 June and from 11 September to 9 October. The water temperature may vary by ±5 °C, depending on the weather and on proper use of the cover. The pool is equipped with a cover that helps retain the heat of the water, so the pool must be covered when it is not in use. Beside the pool there are loungers, two parasols, a side table and an outdoor shower.

The covered terrace offers a pleasant space for dining outdoors, and the summer kitchen is equipped with a gas grill and a sink.

Part of the courtyard is covered with lawn, and the whole property is surrounded by greenery and olive trees, which creates a calm and relaxing atmosphere. Guests have a private parking area and a Tesla Wall Connector charger for electric vehicles.

**A corner for the youngest guests**

We have also given special attention to our youngest guests. A children's play corner has been arranged in the villa, designed to encourage imagination, creativity and independent exploration through play.

Instead of relying on modern electronic toys, we have given priority to simple, creative and traditional ways of playing. Children have a wooden play kitchen with utensils, a stand with a roll of drawing paper and crayons, plush toys, interactive mats, wooden tracks for building and for playing with toy cars and trains, and much more. The toys and activities have been chosen to entertain children of different ages.

For families with babies, a baby cot, a baby bathtub, a feeding chair and children's eating utensils are also available.

Whether you want to spend the day by the pool, relax in the wellness area, enjoy a good book or gather for a shared meal on the terrace, Villa Luxury Ulika offers a place to make beautiful memories in a calm and private setting.

locations.title: What to See and Visit:
des: - Aquacolors Water Park.
- Explore the beautiful islands of Brijuni National Park, rich in natural beauty and cultural heritage.
- Discover the ancient Roman amphitheater in Pula, one of the best-preserved Roman arenas in the world.
- Dive into the underwater world at Pula Aquarium, located near the city center. Explore diverse marine ecosystems, observe various fish species, and learn more about marine conservation.
- Experience thrilling water slides, lazy rivers, and relaxing pools at Istralandia Aquapark near Novigrad. Perfect for families and water lovers, this aquapark offers a fun day for all ages.

inner_list.item2: Long Stay Discounts: Special prices for weekly and monthly bookings

list.des2: For the exact price and availability, feel free to contact us! Book early to secure your perfect private vacation.

Payment_conditions.subtitle: PAYMENT AND RESERVATION TERMS
Payment_conditions.title: Payment and Reservation Terms
Payment_conditions.des: Tourist tax is not included in the price!
Payment_conditions.des2: To secure a reservation, a 30% advance payment of the total amount is required directly to the owner, and the remaining 70% upon arrival.
Payment_conditions.des3: Refundable deposit if everything is in order: €500.
Payment_conditions.des4: Free cancellation available within one week of booking (EXCEPT FOR LAST-MINUTE BOOKINGS, THEN THE DEADLINE IS 48 HOURS). Last-minute booking – two weeks before arrival.
Payment_conditions.des5: On the last day of stay, guests must leave the accommodation by 9:00 AM so other guests can check in from 4:00 PM.
Payment_conditions.des6: Note: Pets are not allowed on the property.

steps.title: Send an Inquiry
steps.des: Please send us an inquiry via the contact form, email, or phone with all the necessary information and your preferred vacation period. Expect a quick response and our best offer.
steps.des2: To confirm your booking, a 30% advance payment is required, and the remaining amount upon arrival. After completing the payment, please notify us, and we’ll send you a booking and payment confirmation. There are two advance payment options: bank transfer or PayPal (debit and credit cards).
steps.subtitle: Bank Transfer
steps.des3: Once payment is completed, we will confirm your reservation. Relax and look forward to your summer vacation at Villa Luxury Ulika, Istria – Croatia!

Environs.title: Vodnjan & Istria
Environs.des: Vodnjan is a charming town located in the heart of Istria, Croatia. Known for its rich history, medieval architecture, and picturesque streets, it offers a glimpse into traditional Istrian life. Surrounded by olive groves, vineyards, and the stunning Adriatic coast, Vodnjan is also famous for its high-quality olive oil production. Nearby attractions include the ancient Roman city of Pula, Brijuni National Park, and beautiful beaches, making it a perfect destination for lovers of nature and history.
Environs.des2: The villa can be reached by car or taxi. Parking is free and available on-site.

Events.title: Our Packages for Unforgettable Celebrations
Events.subtitle:
Would you like to add a special charm to your event and create memories that last?

We’ve prepared three carefully designed packages to suit different occasions – from elegant simplicity to unique experiences that take your breath away. Each package includes **house rental**, ensuring the perfect location for your celebration and unforgettable moments.
Events.p4_des: We offer house rental with a spacious location ideal for organizing larger events. There’s enough space for tent installation, providing flexibility to adapt the ambiance for various occasions – from family celebrations to corporate events. Tent setup can be arranged in cooperation with VISAEM, a trusted partner for professional tent structures and equipment, ensuring quality and safety for every event.

packages.title: BASIC PACKAGE
details: For those who appreciate simplicity with a touch of elegance. Our carefully crafted decorative garland will beautify your space and create a refined atmosphere for any occasion.
Ideal for: small celebrations, intimate gatherings, or events where you wish to highlight beauty in details.

packages.title: STANDARD PACKAGE
details: A combination of elegance and fun! In addition to the garland, this package includes helium balloons that bring playfulness and festivity to the atmosphere. Your guests will feel the special energy, and the whole vibe will be lifted to another level.
Ideal for: birthdays, christenings, corporate celebrations, and any event that deserves an extra touch of festivity.

packages.title: PREMIUM PACKAGE
details: Our most exclusive package is made for those who want more than decoration – they want an experience. In addition to elegant space decoration, it includes an exclusive retro oldtimer ride (up to 1 hour) where you can enjoy and take photos with the car.
Ideal for: anniversaries, celebrations, special gatherings, and events that deserve something different.
